description: Lignes régulières de bus - Hérault (GTFS) is a dataset listed in Hérault Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Occitanie. Descriptions des lignes régulières de bus du département de l'Hérault.. Pour calculer son trajet ou avoir plus de renseignements, rendez-vous sur le site liO de la Région Occitanie:. Coverage: Hérault. The portal files it under Routes, Transports et Mobilités. Its keywords are bus, ligne de bus, lio. The portal shows 68 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-09-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-herault-data-fr-portal.
